tidypockets.protect.swapped: %s is almost broken (%s left): swapped in a fresh one
tidypockets.protect.stowed: %s is almost broken (%s left): moved it to your inventory
tidypockets.protect.blocked: %s is almost broken (%s left): your inventory is full, so it stays put
tidypockets.option.sortEnabled.tooltip: Middle-click (or the Sort key) over an inventory sorts it.
tidypockets.option.sortHotbar.tooltip: Also sort the hotbar when sorting your own inventory. Locked slots never move.
tidypockets.option.sortOrder.tooltip: Creative: like the creative inventory. Name: alphabetical. ID: by item ID.
tidypockets.option.sortSound.tooltip: A soft pop when a sort finishes.
tidypockets.option.safeMode.tooltip: Send sort clicks a few per tick instead of all at once, for servers with strict anti-cheat. Slower.
tidypockets.option.safeModeClicksPerTick: How many clicks safe mode sends each tick.
tidypockets.option.refillEnabled.tooltip: When a stack in your hand runs out, pull a matching one from your inventory.
tidypockets.option.refillExactMatch.tool: Only refill with identical items (same name, enchantments, and so on).
tidypockets.option.refillOffhand.tooltip: Refill the offhand too, e.g. torches.
tidypockets.option.protect.tooltip: Stop tools and weapons from breaking: swap in a spare, or move the tool out of your hand.
tidypockets.option.protectMargin.tooltip: Extra durability to keep. 0 uses a tool down to its last point.
tidypockets.option.wheelMove.tooltip: Scroll over a stack to move one item to the other side; Shift+scroll moves the whole stack.
tidypockets.option.wheelInvert.tooltip: Scroll up to push instead of down.
tidypockets.option.shiftDrag.tooltip: Hold Shift and drag across slots to shift-click them all.
tidypockets.option.collectDrag.tooltip: With items on the cursor, press on a matching stack and drag to gather matching stacks.
tidypockets.option.containerButtons.tool: Sort, deposit and restock buttons on chests and other storage.
tidypockets.option.search.tooltip: Ctrl+F in a container opens a search that highlights matching slots.
tidypockets.option.animSpeed.tooltip: Speed of all Tidy Pockets animations. Off turns them off.
tidypockets.option.animSort.tooltip: Items poof out and pop into their new slots when sorting.
tidypockets.option.animFly.tooltip: Moved items fly to their new slot.
tidypockets.option.animAllScreens.toolti: Pause menu, options and other screens pop open too.
tidypockets.option.animHotbar.tooltip: Gliding selector, refill pop and tool warning shake.
tidypockets.option.animCountBump.tooltip: Stack counts bump when they change.
tidypockets.option.animPlayerHop.tooltip: Your character hops when you equip armour.
tidypockets.option.smoothScroll.tooltip: Lists, the creative inventory and chat scroll smoothly.
tidypockets.option.blur.tooltip: Blur the world behind inventories. Strength follows the Menu Background Blur setting.
tidypockets.option.sortOrder.name: Name
